node: Semiconductor equipment for leading-edge logic, memory, advanced packaging, and test
summary: Expanded the node from EUV lithography into a broader equipment chokepoint cluster: materials engineering, deposition/process tools, process control, advanced packaging metrology, automated test, probe cards, and subsystem inputs. The most relevant US-listed additions are not only large wafer-fab-equipment vendors, but also metrology/test/probe-card and vacuum/photonics/materials suppliers whose demand can rise when AI accelerators, HBM, chiplets, and advanced packaging require higher yield, tighter process windows, and more test intensity. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
